LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY: POEM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we display appropriate expressions when reading a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify techniques of reading fast
2. read a text accurately, with expression and at the right speed
3. apply fluency strategies when reading a text
4. appreciate the value of fluency in reading to enhance understanding

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY: POEM
This lesson teaches Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem above.
2. Explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we display appropriate expressions when reading a text?

2. read a text accurately, with expression and at the right speed
